use bytes::Bytes;

pub mod pdcm_program {
    pub const PROGRAM: u32 = 100666;

    pub mod pdcm_rpc_v8 {
        pub const VERSION: u32 = 8;
        pub const PDCM_NULL: u32 = 0;
        pub const PDCM_DO_COPY: u32 = 1;

        pub struct PDCM_RPC_V8Client<T> {
            client: onc_rpc_runtime::Client<T>,
        }

        impl<T> PDCM_RPC_V8Client<T> where T: onc_rpc_runtime::ClientTransport {
            pub fn new(client: onc_rpc_runtime::Client<T>) -> Self {
                Self { client }
            }

            pub fn pdcm_null(&self) -> Result<onc_rpc_runtime::CallResponse, onc_rpc_runtime::RuntimeError> {
                let request = onc_rpc_runtime::CallRequest::new(
                    onc_rpc_runtime::ProgramVersion { program: super::PROGRAM, version: VERSION },
                    onc_rpc_runtime::Procedure(PDCM_NULL),
                    Bytes::new(),
                );
                self.client.call(request)
            }

            pub fn pdcm_do_copy(&self, payload: Bytes) -> Result<onc_rpc_runtime::CallResponse, onc_rpc_runtime::RuntimeError> {
                let request = onc_rpc_runtime::CallRequest::new(
                    onc_rpc_runtime::ProgramVersion { program: super::PROGRAM, version: VERSION },
                    onc_rpc_runtime::Procedure(PDCM_DO_COPY),
                    payload,
                );
                self.client.call(request)
            }

        }

        pub trait PDCM_RPC_V8Service {
            fn pdcm_null(&self) -> Result<Bytes, onc_rpc_server::DispatchError>;
            fn pdcm_do_copy(&self, payload: Bytes) -> Result<Bytes, onc_rpc_server::DispatchError>;
        }

        pub struct PDCM_RPC_V8Dispatch<T> {
            inner: T,
        }

        impl<T> PDCM_RPC_V8Dispatch<T> {
            pub fn new(inner: T) -> Self {
                Self { inner }
            }
        }

        impl<T> onc_rpc_server::Dispatch for PDCM_RPC_V8Dispatch<T> where T: PDCM_RPC_V8Service + Send + Sync + 'static {
            fn dispatch(&self, request: onc_rpc_server::RequestContext) -> Result<onc_rpc_server::ResponsePayload, onc_rpc_server::DispatchError> {
                match request.procedure.0 {
                    0 => {
                        self.inner.pdcm_null().map(onc_rpc_server::ResponsePayload::success)
                    }
                    1 => {
                        self.inner.pdcm_do_copy(request.payload).map(onc_rpc_server::ResponsePayload::success)
                    }
                    _ => Err(onc_rpc_server::DispatchError::ProcedureUnavailable),
                }
            }
        }

    }

}
